description: Enrich current main table with one or two lookups. New node requires enrichment; existing omission preserves settings only when sources are unchanged.

enrichment.description: Complete replacement of supported lookup key pairs and global prefix settings; no partial table patch.

tables.description: All lookup inputs in ascending unique port order. Input 0 is always the main table.

items.description: One lookup joined directly to the main input, independently of other lookups.

port.description: Lookup input index: 1 or 2; source comes from the matching top-level inputs entry.

keys.description: Complete nonempty composite key; exact compatible technical field names, each used once per table.

items.description: One equality between a main field and this lookup's field; no conversion or expression.

main.description: Observed technical field name on main input 0.

lookup.description: Observed technical field name on this lookup input; excluded from generated output.

prefixes.description: Native global name/label prefixes for lookup fields; final generated names must be read back.

enabled.description: Enable native prefixes for appended lookup fields; main fields stay unchanged.

name.description: Literal native technical name prefix; require valid unambiguous resulting identifiers.

label.description: Literal native display label prefix; independent of technical name prefix.
